fusions.name: Falling Weight
fusions.desc: A weight dropped on a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 30 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach, and ignores its armour.

fusions.name: Slam and Scarper
fusions.desc: Slams the ground, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning each for 1.2 seconds. For 3 seconds after using it, you move 25% faster.

fusions.name: Weighted Feint
fusions.desc: Increases your blunt damage by 30% and your dodge chance by 10% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Tapped Seam
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 5. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a blow strikes it for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (136% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
